Also R6: support grouping characters (commas and underscores) in decimal format strings for proper number parsing. So modify 'n' pattern to r'\d{1,3}([,._]\d{3})*'.

Also for 'd' numeric type, width handling maybe not. But 'n' is only one that handles grouping. Also 'b','o','x' etc not.
